serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
We looked through some other paintings and we have the last one to look at.
You: Do you like this one?
Bot: It’s…{{wi}} an apple.
You: But it’s a nice apple, right? The way the light bends on its surface and how it casts shadow on the table.
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: It looks like a picture…
You: Yeah, it’s very realistic. Very impressive!
Bot: Why paint something like that if he could just take a photo?
You: To showcase his skill and technique maybe?
Bot: It’s impressive and all, but I don’t see a point in seeing an apple. Aren’t paintings supposed to convey something?
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: I’m not sure, I’m not a big art guy myself…
You: As for me, I like this painting. When I look at it I think ‘wow, people really can master something if they work hard’. I kinda wish I found something I liked and got good enough for people to like it.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: With all the technological advances like photography, and AI that can capture or create an image far more detailed than this one I must commend human struggle to keep doing and enjoying these things although I don’t quite understand it.
You: That’s all the painting here. It’s time to go home…
